notes.title: 1.1.3 | Patch Notes 09
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Améliorations / Improvements[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the probability of negative effects from drinking marktails (7% -> 5%).
[*] Improved camera movement in editor (scrolling with the mouse wheel)
[*] Reduced customer unhappiness percentage (6% -> 4%).
[*] Lowered the stain spawn rate on the ground (1 in 8 chance -> 1 in 10 chance).
[*] Adjusted stain spawn frequency during rain to reduce their impact (200% -> 135%).
[*] Happy customers now generate significantly more global happiness (3 -> 7).
[/list]

[h2][b]Fixes / Corrections[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the leaderboard would not load properly.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.1.2 | PATCH NOTES 08
notes.notes:
[h2][b]New features: 
[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Customers will be directed to the nearest cash register with the fewest customers of the three closest.
[*] Redesign of the marktails vending machine
[/list]

[h2][b]Improvements:
[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] You'll no longer hear the protester shouting everywhere; it's now played close to him.
[*] The % before you have too many negative effects from drinking marktails has been reduced.
[/list]

[h2][b]Fix: 
[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed corrupted save problem
[*] Fixed glitch to cancel marktails effect by drinking more marktails (doesn't work like that in real life).
[*] Fixed the glitch that allowed player to drink marktails all night after 8:00 p.m.
[/list]

notes.title: Issue with Update and Status of Version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone,[/b]
We wanted to inform you that we recently identified and fixed a bug affecting in-game missions. However, due to a technical issue with Steam, we are currently unable to publish the update containing this fix.

We will keep you updated as soon as we have more news regarding the release of the update.

[b]Version 1.1.0, which will include this fix along with other improvements, is coming very soon![/b]

Best regards,
Perkaholics Studio
